closure_rules: Start with complete ActionId/status universe; include prerequisite references and nodes required by native validation.
Seed _global_control goal entries, unsatisfied condition goals, boundary action links, all reached action requirements and current_completion support.
Seed evaluate_satisfaction proofs for retained roots/slots; close predicate operands, entity/knowledge/authority/producer/mapping/validator references and assertion dependencies.
Include every REQUIRES relation affecting retained nodes; if declaring ordering assertions preserve exact equality with prerequisite metadata.
Include decision dependency links and reentry routes reached by resume_eligibility; preserve typed reference closure even on short-circuited semantic paths.
Keep corresponding raw source pins/provenance; omit unrelated archived graph entities/assertions, descriptive reports and hypothetical future evidence.
